ferrari-296.author: Alexander Migl
ferrari-296.alt: Ferrari 296 GTB in black, front three-quarter view
ferrari-296.note: 296 GTB berlinetta (2022 on): teardrop headlamps with the DRL 'tear duct' and the flying-buttress rear pillars. Photographed in Böblingen, Germany; same car as sold in India.

ferrari-296.author: Alexander Migl
ferrari-296.alt: Ferrari 296 GTB in dark grey with a yellow stripe, rear three-quarter view
ferrari-296.note: 296 GTB rear with the single central tailpipe and the active spoiler housing between the tail lamps. The yellow stripe is an optional livery.

ferrari-amalfi.file: File:2026 Ferrari Amalfi in Verde Costiera, front right.jpg
ferrari-amalfi.author: Mr.choppers
ferrari-amalfi.alt: Ferrari Amalfi in Verde Costiera, front three-quarter view
ferrari-amalfi.note: Amalfi (2025 on, Roma replacement): black band joining the slim headlamps, lower nose without the Roma's body-coloured mesh grille. Verde Costiera is the Amalfi launch colour.

ferrari-amalfi.author: Alexander Migl
ferrari-amalfi.alt: Ferrari Amalfi in a light metallic beige, rear three-quarter view
ferrari-amalfi.note: Amalfi coupé in a dealer showroom in Böblingen: black glass rear-deck panel with Ferrari lettering and the raised integrated spoiler (checked on a crop), which the Roma lacks.

ferrari-12cilindri.file: File:2025 Ferrari 12Cilindri in Rosso Imola, front left.jpg
ferrari-12cilindri.author: Mr.choppers
ferrari-12cilindri.alt: Ferrari 12Cilindri in Rosso Imola, front three-quarter view
ferrari-12cilindri.note: 12Cilindri (2024 on, 812 replacement): full-width black front band with slim headlamps and the bonnet 'delta' cut-outs. Rosso Imola is a catalogue colour.

ferrari-12cilindri.file: File:2025 Ferrari 12Cilindri in Rosso Imola, rear left.jpg
ferrari-12cilindri.author: Mr.choppers
ferrari-12cilindri.alt: Ferrari 12Cilindri in Rosso Imola, rear three-quarter view
ferrari-12cilindri.note: Same car from the rear: black delta-wing rear window section and twin tailpipe clusters.

ferrari-12cilindri.author: Charles from Port Chester, New York
ferrari-12cilindri.alt: Ferrari 12Cilindri cockpit with black Alcantara and the passenger display
ferrari-12cilindri.note: 12Cilindri cabin with the 12Cilindri script on the dashboard and the dual-cockpit layout.

ferrari-purosangue.file: File:2024 Ferrari Purosangue in Grigio Titanio, front left (Miller).jpg
ferrari-purosangue.author: Mr.choppers
ferrari-purosangue.alt: Ferrari Purosangue in Grigio Titanio, front three-quarter view
ferrari-purosangue.note: Purosangue four-door V12 (2023 on): slim DRL strips above deep-set headlamps and the clamshell bonnet. US dealer car; same design worldwide.

ferrari-purosangue.author: Alexander Migl
ferrari-purosangue.alt: Ferrari Purosangue in silver, rear three-quarter view
ferrari-purosangue.note: Purosangue rear with the floating spoiler, slim tail lamps and twin exhaust pairs.

ferrari-849-testarossa.author: Alexander Migl
ferrari-849-testarossa.alt: Ferrari 849 Testarossa in red with black roof, front three-quarter view
ferrari-849-testarossa.note: 849 Testarossa (2025 on, SF90 Stradale replacement): black front band, vertical side strakes recalling the original Testarossa. Shown on the Ferrari dealer stand at Auto Zürich 2026; no other brands in view.

ferrari-849-testarossa.author: Alexander Migl
ferrari-849-testarossa.alt: Ferrari 849 Testarossa in red, rear three-quarter view
ferrari-849-testarossa.note: Same car from the rear: twin high-mounted exhausts and the black rear deck. Other show cars are in the far background.
